The labelled differences of a comparison

Source: R/methods.R
differences.Rd

The labelled differences of a comparison

Usage

differences(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'pkgdossier_comparison'
differences(
  x,
  kind = NULL,
  scenario = NULL,
  max_severity = NULL,
  no_news = NULL,
  accepted = NULL,
  group = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An pkgdossier_comparison from compare_runs().

...

Must be empty; a misspelled filter (kinds =) is an error rather than an unfiltered table.

kind, scenario

Keep only these kinds of difference (see compare_runs()) or these scenarios.

max_severity

Keep only differences of this severity or more severe (1 is the most severe; unstable steps have severity 0).

no_news

TRUE keeps only differences in steps that no NEWS bullet names (see "NEWS candidates" in compare_runs()); FALSE keeps only those with a candidate bullet.

accepted

TRUE keeps only accepted differences, FALSE only the others (see accept_differences()).

group

TRUE gives one row per distinct change instead of one per occurrence: rows of the same kind with the same base and cand and the same path below the object (*$summary$se for both m1$summary$se and m2$summary$se) are one change, with columns n (occurrences), steps (number of steps) and where (the first few scenario/step). A new field in a model object, found in every step that holds such an object, is then one row.

Value

A data frame with one row per difference, most severe first: scenario, step, label, kind, severity, path (where in the step: an element path, "printed", "console", "warning", "error", "plot" or "time"), base and cand (the two sides, as text), rel_change (for numbers and timings), detail, news (the candidate NEWS bullets for the step, one per line, or NA) no_news (TRUE when there are none; NA when the candidate has no NEWS file that could be read), and accepted and accepted_reason (see accept_differences()).

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
differences(cmp, kind = c("error_new", "field_removed"))
#>   scenario   step  label          kind severity  path base
#> 1      api result result field_removed        1 res$b <NA>
#> 2      api  check  check     error_new        1 error <NA>
#>                    cand rel_change                      detail
#> 1                  <NA>         NA                        <NA>
#> 2 `x` must be character         NA simpleError/error/condition
#>                                                                 news no_news
#> 1                                                               <NA>    TRUE
#> 2 `check_input()` now requires character input and errors otherwise.   FALSE
#>   accepted accepted_reason
#> 1    FALSE            <NA>
#> 2    FALSE            <NA>
differences(cmp, max_severity = 2)
#>       scenario          step             label                    kind severity
#> 1          api         noisy             noisy                unstable        0
#> 2          api        result            result           field_removed        1
#> 3          api         check             check               error_new        1

#> 8  ex_estimate         ex-02          est$main             value_moved        2

#> 11         api     err_class         err_class condition_class_changed        2
